propertyDetails.description: Embrace vibrant Bay Meadows living in this stunning 2-bed, 2.5-bath townhouse. This home offers the most coveted location in the community, overlooking Paddock Park. Bask in the sunlit open-concept great room with bookend balconies. The living and dining rooms flow into the expansive gourmet chef's kitchen, featuring dining peninsula, quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, & gas range. Indulge in the tranquility of park views from your living room balcony and dine alfresco on the inviting kitchen terrace. The top floor boasts two ensuite bedrooms and laundry area. Retreat to the stylish primary suite with custom wood accent wall, walk-in closet and elegant bathroom, featuring dual vanity and glass-enclosed shower. Additional upgrades include hardwood floors, built-in speakers, & custom garage storage. Enjoy the ultimate urban lifestyle offered at Bay Meadows, with access to multiple parks, playgrounds, a vibrant community garden, & BBQ area. Incredible proximity to Caltrain, Whole Foods, Hillsdale Shopping Center, Fieldworks Brewery, & Blue Bottle. With its prime location and easy access to major thoroughfares such as 101, 92, & 280, this residence offers a stylish abode and serves as your gateway to a refined and connected living experience.
